verdict.rationale: Cake's own docs cover the core cap-table records: share classes, SAFEs and option grants, digital certificate management (holdings and transactional types, plus linking externally issued certificates), and a live cap table view. Investors can view their holdings through the My Cake portal. Nothing in the pack shows auditors relying on the cap table, so the story's 'single source of truth for investors and auditors' element is only partly covered, and all evidence is vendor-claimed. missing for 10: evidence of auditor access, audit trail or audit-grade reporting, and independent or hands-on corroboration that investors and auditors rely on it.

support.subject: As a founder, I can maintain my full cap table — share classes, certificates, SAFEs, and option grants — as a live single source of truth that investors and auditors rely on

citations.quote: for those five you get the whole product: share classes, SAFEs, option grants, stakeholder portals and round modelling
